comments.quote: Facilities: The overall maintenance is OK. The room we booked is very spacious. I like the bathroom the most. It is big, with mountains next to it. It looks green. It is very comfortable and relaxing to take a bath....

comments.quote: It was my first time in Moganshan, and I was a little overwhelmed by the choices of B&Bs. I finally decided on this one and was very satisfied! First of all, the lobby on the first floor is very beautiful...

comments.quote: The homestay is very, very beautiful. The lady boss is very nice and welcoming! In the morning, she will prepare delicious breakfast. In the afternoon, she will prepare fruits for resting in the room. She will also pick you up...
